note: No new idea today. The sweep found nothing that changes our code. Two things to know: Remotion 5.0 (not out yet) will count contractors in its free-licence team size, and we are pinned to 4.0.250, so nothing changes unless someone upgrades. Claude Code 2.1.296-2.1.298 could run a tool call twice in headless runs (fixed in 2.1.299).

questions: Did Claude Code or the API change anything this week that touches our claude -p workers (flags, caching, cost, double tool calls)?
Is there a better way to show 'approval waiting' items in an agent dashboard than our Today page (ui focus)?
Does the Remotion 5.0 plan change our licence position or our render commands?
Is any new open-source repo a real fit for our Shorts pipeline or our Claude Code setup?
gaps: The ui search returned only secondary blogs (grade C); nothing showed our Today/Needs-you design is wrong, so I made no ui idea.
Could not read GitHub repo pages for wshobson/agents and arena-skill (API returned 403 to the fetcher); their stars are from earlier runs.
Remotion's licence page text did not load, so team-size thresholds for 4.x/5.0 are not confirmed today (the migration page only says contractors will count).
No official YouTube page defines 'Viewed vs swiped away' in the API; Analytics API availability of Shorts retention is still unconfirmed.
Changelog entries 2.1.297 and 2.1.298 do not appear on the page, so I could not check them.

new_today: Claude Code 2.1.299: fixes a 2.1.296 regression where cloud and headless sessions could run an approved tool call twice when a new message arrived as a session resumed after a restart (our workers use --no-session-persistence, so the risk was low)
Claude Code 2.1.299: idle compaction before the 1-hour cache expires (interactive, not relevant to one-shot claude -p); /usage now warns about max effort and large tool results
Claude Code 2.1.296: Sonnet 5.5 cache reads priced at $0.10/M in /cost and --max-budget-usd (already noted 13 Oct)

Remotion 5.0 is announced but not released: contractors will count toward team size, the licence is tied to new terms, company licences must enable telemetry. We pin remotion and @remotion/cli at 4.0.250 in animation/package.json
No new Anthropic models or news since 8 Oct (Usage Policy, Cyber Mission); API notes unchanged since 9 Oct
Telegram Bot API: latest I can find is 10.2 (14 Jul 2026); nothing newer found
